name: 46567 · Syracuse, IN
findings: ZIP 46567 (Syracuse) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46567 (Syracuse) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
45% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 46567 (Syracuse) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.
